This is clearly the same entity with spelling and legal-suffix drift. Per the rules: "spelling drift, legal-suffix drift, accent differences = same-entity."

Best value: which to pick? The rules say for same-entity, presumably keep the register's canonical form (the register is the canonical database). The rules specify best_value for different-entity = document's; for document-noise = register's; for same-entity with number/year format differences = register's canonical form. For same-entity generally, the fused record should carry the register's canonical form. The register value also includes the (ZEMIC) abbreviation, which is useful. So best_value = register value.
